description: This file defines the Tax class within the OpenCart e-commerce system, responsible for handling tax calculations, setting tax-related addresses (shipping, payment, store), retrieving tax rate information, and managing tax rate data within the cart subsystem.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Class for managing tax calculations and tax rule configurations within the cart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Tax object with database and configuration objects from the registry.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the provided shipping address (country and zone).

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the provided payment address (country and zone).

methods.name: setStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the store address (country and zone).

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total amount including tax for a given value and tax class.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the total tax amount for a given value and tax class.

methods.name: getRateName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a specific tax rate.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Retrieves detailed tax rate data for a given value and tax class.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cached tax rate data.
